info.title: BlissNova Ad Network API
info.description: Versioned REST API. Management endpoints use session cookies (with CSRF header) or organization API keys; public ad-serving endpoints are unauthenticated and keyed by public site keys.

post.description: Issue a new verification challenge (a fresh high-entropy token) for one method. Any earlier open challenge for the site is superseded.
Check the open challenge now. Safe to retry while DNS propagates.
DEVELOPMENT ONLY. Simulates a successful verification for a reserved local hostname (localhost, *.localhost, *.test, *.example). Unavailable in production.
Submit a verified site for policy and eligibility review. Verification alone never approves a site.

get.description: The line this site should list in its ads.txt, and the result of the last check.

post.description: Fetch the site's /ads.txt now and look for the BlissNova line.

put.description: Let the ad tag insert ads between article paragraphs, using one in-page placement.

get.description: Aggregated performance from validated events. CTR = valid clicks / valid impressions x 100.
Per-page performance. Page views are pages where the ad tag requested at least one ad. Page RPM = estimated earnings / page views x 1000.

post.description: Start a funding payment. Funds are credited only after the provider confirms by verified webhook, or after finance staff confirm a manual transfer.
Request ads for one or more placements on a page. Unauthenticated; keyed by the public site key and restricted to the site's registered domains.
Report rendered and viewable impressions. Accepts application/json or text/plain (sendBeacon).

get.description: Click-tracking redirect. Redirects only to the destination stored for the creative; the URL cannot be supplied by the caller.
Automatic in-article placement settings, read by the ad tag when its script has data-auto.

post.description: Confirm receipt of a manual bank transfer. Only for providers without webhooks.
Record a refund issued through the provider or bank. Debits the advertiser wallet.
Record that funds were sent (manual payouts). Requires the bank or provider reference.

get.description: Event-level investigation. Raw events are retained only for the configured retention period.

post.description: Exclude matching events from billable totals. Settled charges are reversed with new ledger entries.

get.description: Outside networks this account can extend CPC campaigns to.

put.description: Choose the partner networks a CPC campaign also runs on, and the most of its budget each may spend.

get.description: Delivery and spend by source: the BlissNova network and each partner network.

apiBaseUrl.description: Your API base URL (PUBLIC_API_URL). localhost is the local demo.
